beats.say: 11 Emmy nominations still could not save Kristen Wiig's Palm Royale.
9to5Mac reports that Apple TV has cancelled Palm Royale after two seasons.
You might expect award winners to stick around.
According to 9to5Mac, the show won Outstanding Original Main Title Theme Music.
It brought Julie McDaniel's 2018 novel Mr. and Mrs. American Pie to your screens.
Yet Wiig's Maxine Simmons has officially bowed out after season two.
